results.notes: Built to the row, all switches untouched (the slice adds none). The model-gateway deployment allowlist refusal (ALLOWED_MODELS) is now a typed 403 body {"error":{code:"model_not_entitled",message,retryable:false,action:"choose_another_model",details:{model,reason:"deployment_allowlist"}}} from the pure fn deployment_allowlist_refusal in normalize.rs (the unary path returns it unchanged; the stream path in sse.rs reads the nested shape via Refusal::from_body and emits an error frame with code model_not_entitled, message and retryable; the flat {"error": "..."} shape is unchanged). mp-contracts model_entitlement.rs holds code::{MODEL_NOT_ENTITLED, ENTITLEMENT_UNAVAILABLE}, Reason (5, the matrix vocabulary), Action, Refusal builders (not_entitled, unavailable), json_body, grpc_status (PERMISSION_DENIED / UNAVAILABLE, never FAILED_PRECONDITION; trailers x-mp-provider-error and x-mp-entitlement-reason), from_body/from_status, catalogue_json/catalogue_text, and wire_model_id (the caller-supplied model id is echoed only if it is <=128 bytes of model-id characters, so refusal bodies stay content-free). The golden model-entitlement-refusals.json (+.sha256, pin d8b48550...a647a) is generated (MP_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 cargo test -p mp-contracts --test model_entitlement_catalogue). tests/model_entitlement_catalogue.rs also evaluates the matrix's refusal row (r_refusal_is_content_free) and the refusing availability rows against the real builders. SPA: model-entitlement-refusals.ts (Norwegian first, English = golden verbatim) wired into streamFailurePresentation: model_not_entitled -> no retry, text says choose another model; model_entitlement_unavailable -> retry. No proto change, no migration, no Cargo.toml change needed (serde_json/tonic already there). The gRPC invoke handler is not wired (the gate is not on that path today; S4 adds admission there), so the gRPC builder is tested but has no caller yet.
